name: Ente Nazionale per l'Aviazione Civile
notes: Role confirmed on enac.gov.it (site title 'Ente Nazionale per l'Aviazione Civile'; the Italian civil aviation authority, with a Drones section and aircraft registry). Logos are PNG files served by enac.gov.it in the site header (colour: cropped-enac-logo.png) and footer (white: enac-logo-bianco.png), tier 2, website-served; both 594x842 RGBA. No brand page or logo-use terms located (a Board resolution 25/2021 on the institutional logo restyling exists as a PDF on enac.gov.it; it was not used as a source), so redistribution rights are not confirmed. ENAC's drone-entities page warns recognised entities not to use the ENAC logo in ways implying endorsement.
